# Donald Trump Approval Rating Slumps in 7 of 8 States Canada Targeted

Published

Sep 16, 2026 at 09:38 AM EDT

Sam Stevenson

Associate News Editor

President Donald Trump’s net approval rating has fallen in seven of eight states that Ontario Premier Doug Ford urged Canada to target with additional tariffs because of their political importance to the president’s base, according to Civiqs tracking.
